_about: Google Compute Engine virtual machine prices in US dollars per machine-hour, as Google's own page shows them: nothing here is converted. Compute only (no disk, network or storage). Every entry carries the page it was read from (source) and the day it was read (read_on). Do not guess a number here (no entry, no price). Only the Spot price was read on 2026-10-24; the on-demand (standard) price was not on a page that could be read, so no machine type has a standard price yet and a standard-priced task is shown as unknown.
